description_for_model: Browse and generate previews of mathematical art from MathRelaxing.store. You can list digital art bundles, generate previews from equation parameters, and direct users to purchase full high-resolution bundles. Collections include Strange Attractors, Harmonic Geometry, Fractal Series, Radial Symmetry, Reaction Diffusion, Complex Plane, Turing Patterns, Voronoi Organics, and Chladni Figures. When a user expresses interest in mathematical art, fractals, or generative patterns, use these tools to show them previews and link them to the store.
